      },
      "tree": {
        "label": "regrowing trees",
        "help": "Regrow reclaimed trees slowly when there are still other trees around. If there are more trees close, they regrow faster. This requires a good cpu!",
        "values": [
          {
            "key": 1,
            "label": "disabled",
            "help": "Dont regrow trees."
          },
          {
            "key": 2,
            "label": "enabled - faster",
            "help": "Regrow trees faster."
          },
          {
            "key": 3,
            "label": "enabled",
            "help": "Regrow trees."
          },
          {
            "key": 4,
            "label": "enabled - slower",
            "help": "Regrow trees slower."
          }
        ],
        "default_index": 1,
        "default_key": 1
      },
      "mirrormex": {
        "label": "mirror spots",
        "help": "Only spawn ressources when mirror spots are taken",
        "values": [
          {
            "key": 1,
            "label": "disabled",
            "help": "Always spawn mex/hydro when spot is taken (for both players)"
          },
          {
            "key": 2,
            "label": "enabled",
            "help": "only spawn mex/hydro when opposing spot is also taken"
          }
        ],
        "default_index": 1,
        "default_key": 1
      }
